# ingested at

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ingestedAt`](gmeow-ingestedAt.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ingestedAt>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

When an import activity recorded its claims into the system — the transaction time. Distinct from [`gmeow:assertedAt`](gmeow-assertedAt.md) (observation) and gmeow:validFrom/validUntil (validity).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](../classes/gmeow-ImportActivity.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ingestedAt`](gmeow-ingestedAt.md) from [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](../classes/gmeow-ImportActivity.md) to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to stamp a [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](../classes/gmeow-ImportActivity.md) with its transaction time — the instant the system learned the claims — so bitemporal queries can separate when-learned from when-asserted and when-valid.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the observation time of a claim (statement-level [`gmeow:assertedAt`](gmeow-assertedAt.md)) or the time a fact holds in the world ([`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md)); collapsing the three temporal axes defeats the bitemporal model.

### How to use

- Attach exactly one [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) to the [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](../classes/gmeow-ImportActivity.md) (it is functional); pair it with [`gmeow:wasAssociatedWith`](gmeow-wasAssociatedWith.md) for the importing agent, and let the ingested claims carry their own [`gmeow:assertedAt`](gmeow-assertedAt.md) on the statement layer.

### Examples

- ex:import2026 [`gmeow:ingestedAt`](gmeow-ingestedAt.md) "2026-06-15T09:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
